events.description: Iraqi delegation reportedly met Usama bin Ladin in Afghanistan. The meeting was arranged through an Egyptian friend. Its stated main objective was to coordinate activities with anti-US Islamic extremist organizations. The exact meeting date is not legible and the report was transmitted 16 Mar 1999.

An Iraqi delegation met Usama bin Ladin in Afghanistan. The meeting was arranged through an Egyptian friend, and its objective was to coordinate activities with anti-US Islamic extremist organizations. The exact date is excised; the report is dated March 1999.

The CIA disseminated an information report on the Iraqi delegation's meeting with bin Ladin. The report is marked as not finally evaluated intelligence and carries the time-of-transmission stamp TOT 161436Z MAR 99.

key_claims: A CIA report from March 1999 states that an Iraqi delegation met Usama bin Ladin in Afghanistan.
The meeting was reportedly arranged through an Egyptian friend.
The meeting's main objective was reportedly to coordinate activities with anti-US Islamic extremist organizations.
The report is unevaluated raw intelligence and is heavily excised in the declassified copy.
